ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2014-06-30..2026-06-30; paid facts exist only inside that span and are not used; both tags file quarterly facts in the last 8 quarters ending 2026-06-30 and neither has stopped — declared is primary (paid becomes primary only when the declared tag has had no fact for 330 days while paid continues)
dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2025-01-01..2025-12-31) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
dividends.price_note: price: neither prices.json nor score.json carries a price — yields null
dividends.shares_source: quarter ended 2026-06-30 weighted-average diluted count, fallback: no undimensioned period-end / cover-page share count in EDGAR companyfacts (a dual-class filer's cover-page and balance-sheet counts are class-dimensioned and dropped by the API)
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

dividend_yield.label: —
dividend_yield.note: dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-30 and 2026-03-31) — FY2025 DPS 6.45 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 1.6, 2026-06-30: 1.6) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 1.55, 2025-06-30: 1.55)

notes: buybacks: quarters left out (not a sign error) — quarter ended 2024-12-31: the year-to-date facts decrease (2024-01-01..2024-09-30 = 5,342,000 > 2024-01-01..2024-12-31 = 5,341,000) — no quarter can be derived from them (the quarterly row read -1,000; typically a line tagged in one filing and not in the next); left out (a missing quarter)

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-30 and 2026-03-31) — FY2025 DPS 6.45 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 1.6, 2026-06-30: 1.6) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 1.55, 2025-06-30: 1.55)

shares: market cap uses the quarter ended 2026-06-30 weighted-average diluted count, fallback: no undimensioned period-end / cover-page share count in EDGAR companyfacts (a dual-class filer's cover-page and balance-sheet counts are class-dimensioned and dropped by the API)
